question.worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic secant function is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arsech}⁡x)=-\frac{1}{x\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}.
$$

Using the formula above with the chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x-2)-\operatorname{arsech}⁡(3x-2)) \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x-2))\,-\,\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arsech}⁡(3x-2)) \\  & =\frac{3}{3x-2}-(-\frac{1}{(3x-2)\sqrt{1-(3x-2)^{2}}})\cdot (3x-2)^{′} \\  & =\frac{3}{3x-2}\,+\,\frac{1}{(3x-2)\sqrt{1-(3x-2)^{2}}}\cdot 3 \\  & =\frac{3}{3x-2}(1+\frac{1}{\sqrt{\,1-(3x-2)^{2}\,}}).\end{aligned}
$$
